main.intent: Experimental texture candidate; noise-model factors verified in process memory, photographic benefit not yet conclusive.

night.status: Night Sight capture and preference application verified; neutral noise factors retained because trials did not establish a repeatable improvement.

capture_recommendations.motion: Static scene; keep device steady during multiframe capture.
capture_recommendations.color: Preserve existing calibration; no measured color-target correction.
capture_recommendations.awb: System AWB by default; Google AWB comparison cools mixed-light shadows. No calibrated color improvement established.
capture_recommendations.scope: Noise factors also affect Photo; pref_camera_gawb_b_ns and pref_af_mode_back are shared rear settings. Night Sight must be selected in the UI.

night-google-awb.status: Optional colder rendering under mixed illumination; color accuracy not calibrated.
